passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was a king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David praised God in his writings.
David often spoke about God’s faithfulness and mercy.
David encouraged others to worship God.
David’s psalms are prayers and songs to God.

passages.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks to his own soul.
David tells his soul to bless the LORD.
David commands all that is within him to bless the LORD’s holy name.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־ קְ֝רָבַ֗י אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds— He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases, who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion, who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to his own soul.
He tells his soul to bless the LORD.
He tells his soul not to forget the LORD’s kind deeds.
The LORD forgives all your sins.
The LORD heals all your diseases.
The LORD redeems your life from the Pit.
The LORD crowns you with loving devotion and compassion.
The LORD satisfies you with good things.
The LORD renews your youth like the eagle’s.
passages.original: בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וְאַל־ תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כָּל־ גְּמוּלָֽיו׃ הַסֹּלֵ֥חַ לְכָל־ עֲוֺנֵ֑כִי הָ֝רֹפֵ֗א לְכָל־ תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְכִי׃ הַגּוֹאֵ֣ל מִשַּׁ֣חַת חַיָּ֑יְכִי הַֽ֝מְעַטְּרֵ֗כִי חֶ֣סֶד וְרַחֲמִֽים׃ הַמַּשְׂבִּ֣יַע בַּטּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑ךְ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּנֶּ֣שֶׁר נְעוּרָֽיְכִי׃

passages.text: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
passages.sermon: The LORD acts with righteousness.\r\nThe LORD brings justice.\r\nThe LORD helps all who are oppressed.
passages.original: עֹשֵׂ֣ה צְדָק֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטִ֗ים לְכָל־ עֲשׁוּקִֽים׃

passages.text: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.
passages.sermon: The LORD is the subject.\r\nThe LORD made His ways known to Moses.\r\nThe LORD showed His deeds to the people of Israel.
passages.original: יוֹדִ֣יעַ דְּרָכָ֣יו לְמֹשֶׁ֑ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֲלִילֽוֹתָיו׃

passages.text: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is compassionate.
The LORD is gracious.
The LORD is slow to anger.
The LORD abounds in loving devotion.
passages.original: רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֣וּן יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֖רֶךְ אַפַּ֣יִם וְרַב־ חָֽסֶד׃

passages.text: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is compassionate and gracious.
He is slow to anger.
He is abounding in loving devotion.
He will not always accuse us.
He will not keep His anger forever.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ לָנֶ֥צַח יָרִ֑יב וְלֹ֖א לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִטּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is compassionate and gracious.
He is slow to anger.
He abounds in loving devotion.
He has not dealt with us as our sins deserve.
He has not repaid us according to our iniquities.
passages.original: לֹ֣א כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ עָ֣שָׂה לָ֑נוּ וְלֹ֥א כַ֝עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗ינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God shows loving devotion.
God gives this loving devotion to those who fear Him.
God’s loving devotion is very great.
The heavens are high above the earth.
God’s loving devotion is as great as the height of the heavens above the earth.
passages.original: כִּ֤י כִגְבֹ֣הַּ שָׁ֭מַיִם עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ גָּבַ֥ר חַ֝סְדּ֗וֹ עַל־ יְרֵאָֽיו׃

passages.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
passages.sermon:
God removes our transgressions from us.
He takes our sins far away.
He separates our sins from us as far as the east is from the west.
No distance on earth is greater than this.
God does this for us.
passages.original: כִּרְחֹ֣ק מִ֭זְרָח מִֽמַּֽעֲרָ֑ב הִֽרְחִ֥יק מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ אֶת־ פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
passages.sermon:
A father shows compassion to his children.
The LORD shows compassion to those who fear Him.
The LORD acts with kindness and care toward those who honor Him.
The LORD treats those who respect Him as a loving father treats his children.
passages.original: כְּרַחֵ֣ם אָ֭ב עַל־ בָּנִ֑ים רִחַ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל־ יְרֵאָֽיו׃

passages.text: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
passages.sermon: God knows how He made us.\r\nGod remembers that we are dust.
passages.original: כִּי־ ה֖וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־ עָפָ֥ר אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

passages.text: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field; when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
passages.sermon:
Man lives only a short time.
His life is like grass.
He grows and flourishes like a flower in a field.
A wind blows over him.
He is gone.
His place does not remember him anymore.
passages.original: אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִ֣יר יָמָ֑יו כְּצִ֥יץ הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה כֵּ֣ן יָצִֽיץ׃ כִּ֤י ר֣וּחַ עָֽבְרָה־ בּ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְלֹא־ יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children— to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD shows loving devotion.
His loving devotion lasts forever.
He gives this loving devotion to those who fear Him.
The LORD acts with righteousness.
He gives His righteousness to the children and grandchildren of those who fear Him.
He gives this to people who keep His covenant.
He gives this to people who remember His commands.
He gives this to people who obey His commands.
passages.original: וְחֶ֤סֶד יְהוָ֨ה׀ מֵעוֹלָ֣ם וְעַד־ ע֭וֹלָם עַל־ יְרֵאָ֑יו וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים׃ לְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑וֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵ֥י פִ֝קֻּדָ֗יו לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the subject.
The LORD has power and authority.
The LORD has set up His throne.
His throne is in heaven.
The LORD rules as King.
His kingdom rules over everything.
His rule covers all creation.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בַּ֭שָּׁמַיִם הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכוּת֗וֹ בַּכֹּ֥ל מָשָֽׁלָה׃

passages.text: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He has angels.
His angels are mighty in strength.
His angels carry out His word.
His angels listen to the voice of His command.
Bless the LORD, all His angels.
passages.original: בָּרֲכ֥וּ יְהוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He rules over all.
He has many hosts.
His hosts are His servants.
His servants do His will.
All His hosts should bless the LORD.
All His servants who do His will should bless the LORD.
passages.original: בָּרֲכ֣וּ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ צְבָאָ֑יו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
passages.sermon:
The LORD rules over all places.
He has power everywhere.
Everything He made should bless the LORD.
My soul, bless the LORD.
passages.original: בָּרֲכ֤וּ יְהוָ֨ה׀ כָּֽל־ מַעֲשָׂ֗יו בְּכָל־ מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑וֹ בָּרֲכִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
